title: Voice Note Transcriber Pipeline
tagline: Decode real PCM WAV bytes, segment activity by energy, and assemble timestamped transcripts through an injected transcription provider.
summary: Decode real PCM WAV bytes, segment activity by energy, and assemble timestamped transcripts through an injected transcription provider.
youWillBuild: Decode real PCM WAV bytes, segment activity by energy, and assemble timestamped transcripts through an injected transcription provider.

languageWhy.Python: Stdlib data structures, explicit algorithms and deterministic local tests.

stages.title: Decode and validate PCM WAV samples
stages.summary: The bytes encoding [0, 0.5, -0.5] decode to those exact normalized values.
stages.languageWhy: Python standard-library collections, bytes and file operations expose this stage directly.

stages.title: Segment speech candidates with RMS energy
stages.summary: Two active 40 ms regions separated by 20 ms silence merge into one 100 ms region.
stages.languageWhy: Python standard-library collections, bytes and file operations expose this stage directly.

stages.title: Call an injected transcriber with bounded retries
stages.summary: A provider timeout followed by success records attempts=2 and the segment audio hash.
stages.languageWhy: Python standard-library collections, bytes and file operations expose this stage directly.

stages.title: Export validated WebVTT captions
stages.summary: A 1.234-second offset renders as 00:00:01.234, and malformed cue order is rejected.
stages.languageWhy: Python standard-library collections, bytes and file operations expose this stage directly.
